subject: Phoenix executive workshop — venue change & attendee travel diversion
messages:
From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acme-energy.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Phoenix exec workshop — travel update

Hi Dylan / Marissa / Connor,

Quick heads-up: our VP of Product, Daniel Price, was just diverted to Tucson due to heavy thunderstorms on the Phoenix approach. The airline estimates a ~2 hour delay for re-routing + baggage handling. Hes trying to get a rental but ETA is shaky.

We still expect the rest of the execs to arrive on time. Two asks: can the session with Daniel be moved later (afternoon) or run virtually for his portion? Also curious if the venue can hold off on lunch setup until we confirm final headcount. I attached the attendee list and the latest agenda in case you need it.

Apologies for the last-minute disruption — were on standby and will update as soon as we know more.

Thanks,
Laura Jensen
Head of Strategic Accounts | Acme Energy
laura.jensen@acme-energy.com
(555) 867-3021

Attachment: agenda-phoenix-0615.pdf
From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acme-energy.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Walker <ops@phoenix-hotel.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Phoenix exec workshop — travel update

Thanks for the update, Laura. Good to know early. We have a few options and we should pick one quickly: 

- Option A: Delay official start by 90 minutes, keep in-person agenda intact, run Daniels portion once he arrives.
- Option B: Start on time, run the opening and client-facing product demo with in-person execs, and run Daniels session remotely (we can set up a direct Zoom to his phone if needed).
- Option C: Move the morning roundtables to breakout rooms and do the keynote + strategic session in the afternoon when Daniel arrives (keeps full-day outcomes).

Alyssa  can the hotel hold the main room until 14:00 if we delay? Also any constraints on catering if we shift lunch later?

Marissa / Connor  whats your comfort level on hybrid for an exec session? Connor, can you confirm AV setup capacity and a quick run-of-show?

Im leaning toward Option A (delay start) to keep the in-person energy, but curious what logistics look like.

- Dylan
Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198
From: Alyssa Walker <ops@phoenix-hotel.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acme-energy.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Phoenix exec workshop — travel update

Hi all,

We can absolutely hold the Grand Horizon ballroom until 14:00 without penalty, and the AV team is on call. If you delay lunch, we can push plated service by 75-90 minutes (we need a 45-minute final headcount by 10:30 to ensure staffing).

Attached is the updated floorplan showing the hybrid AV positions (camera 1 on podium, camera 2 front row). If youd like additional mics for remote panelists, we can add them; its a small incremental charge but we can absorb in event credit.

Best,
Alyssa Walker
Event Operations Manager
Phoenix Grand Hotel
ops@phoenix-hotel.com

Attachment: floorplan_phoenix_lobby.pdf
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acme-energy.com>
Cc: Alyssa Walker <ops@phoenix-hotel.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Phoenix exec workshop — travel update

Thanks Alyssa + team. I agree with Dylans instinct to keep the day in-person if possible. Practical plan:

- Push official start by 90 minutes (start at 10:30 -> 12:00 for opening + AM breakouts adjusted). That gives Daniel time to arrive and join in-person for the strategic session after lunch.
- Well run a short hybrid intro at the original start time (08:45) for remote participants only: 15-minute welcome + housekeeping, then break into in-person breakout tables. That keeps momentum for those already onsite.
- Connor: can you confirm Zoom bridge for one remote participant (Daniel) + livestream recording for internal stakeholders? Also confirm we can do a remote backup in case Daniel remains on the phone.
- Ill update the attendee list and push a calendar update with the new start time if everyone agrees.

If we need to pivot to fully virtual for Daniels session, well mark the afternoon strategic session as hybrid with a dedicated QA mic.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0223
From: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acme-energy.com>
Cc: Alyssa Walker <ops@phoenix-hotel.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Phoenix exec workshop — travel update

Confirmed on AV: we can support a single hybrid speaker joining from a phone or laptop + livestream recording. AV summary:

- Hardware: 2 PTZ cameras, wired podium mic, 4 wireless lav mics, room mix to Zoom + local recording.
- Capacity: up to 120 concurrent remote viewers; well run the Zoom meeting from my laptop and feed the room audio in.
- Backup: if Daniel is on the phone with poor audio, we can patch the phone line to the room mixer; please have him call the meeting number rather than rely on mobile speaker only.

I attached a 1-page run-of-show with timestamps for the hybrid transition points. Ill be onsite at 09:00 to test and can do a dry run at 10:00.

Attachment: av-runofshow-0615.pdf

- Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acme-energy.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Walker <ops@phoenix-hotel.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Phoenix exec workshop — travel update

All, thanks for the fast responses and the flexibility. Final plan based on availability and AV confirmation: 

- Delay official start to 10:30 (90 minute delay).
- 09:00-10:15: optional remote welcome + short live stream for partners who are joining remotely (15 minutes).
- 10:30-12:30: adjusted opening + moderated product demos (in-person).
- 14:00: strategic exec session with Daniel — hybrid if hes remote; in-person if he arrives.
- Catering: Alyssa will push lunch by 75 minutes as discussed; final headcount confirmed at 10:30.

Action items: 
- Marissa: push updated calendar and attendee list to the SharePoint link (https://acme-energy.sharepoint.com/sites/events/attendee-list) and send a 1-line note to execs about the 90-minute shift.
- Connor: run the AV dry run at 10:00 and post the Zoom link to the shared meeting doc.
- Alyssa: hold the ballroom and proceed with the updated floorplan.

Ill send the calendar update now and update our meeting record: https://redwood.app/meetings/rdw-2026-1293. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround here.

- Dylan
Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: agenda-phoenix-0615.pdf, floorplan_phoenix_lobby.pdf
